projects.title: OSINT / Neural
projects.bodyText:
- A searchable research-tool atlas presented as an interactive 3D neural map, with 167 clusters, saved services and dated catalog evidence.
- Separates page availability from scoped functional verification. The public explorer is static; background investigation commands are available only in the separately configured local runtime.
- Source remains private. The public case study documents the architecture, actual interface and verification boundaries without exposing job history or investigation targets.
projects.rebuildNote: Original project. Public catalog, private source. Reviewed landing-page capture; no private searches or account data are published.

projects.title: Vantage Visual Intelligence
projects.bodyText:
- A private visual-investigation workspace with source-image preservation, inspection jobs, reviewed observations and case exports.
- React and FastAPI connect a tenant-isolated PostgreSQL data model, private object storage and asynchronous workers. Model outputs are hypotheses, not proof of identity, location or authenticity.
- The public pilot has its own account boundary. Source, customer cases and uploaded evidence remain private; this showcase contains only the public landing page and reviewed technical description.
projects.rebuildNote: Original private-source pilot. No customer evidence is shown. Deployment is not a claim of forensic accuracy, accreditation or production certification.

projects.title: Overlay Studio
projects.bodyText:
- A creator-facing streaming design studio with coordinated scenes, webcam frames, panels and animated assets.
- A deterministic design engine shares its renderer between previews and exported artwork; an asynchronous Bun, Redis and FFmpeg pipeline handles render jobs and account-owned packages.
- The public website is a preview. Hosted generation requires a configured render service, and paid checkout is not enabled. Source and private account libraries remain private.
projects.rebuildNote: Original private-source project. The screenshot is the public landing page; paid commerce and production rendering availability are not implied.

projects.title: MyMecho
projects.bodyText:
- A Nigerian auto-care mobile experience for drivers and mechanics, covering service requests, offers, booking conversations and job progress.
- The showcased Android demo uses fictional participants and device-local data. Its customer and mechanic journeys include cancellations, availability and roadside scenarios.
- A connected backend and staff workspace are under development, separate from the demo shown here. No real dispatch or payment is claimed; source and prerelease builds remain private.
projects.rebuildNote: Original private-source project. Screens are from the September 10 Android demo with sample data, not a live service or a newly verified connected release.

projects.title: Prankshit Studio
projects.bodyText:
- A browser-local creative workspace with 37 tools for fictional screen props, conversation storyboards and document mockups.
- Shared React renderers support device/theme previews, validated draft import, PNG/SVG/PDF output and browser-encoded conversation video. PDF work is additive layering, not secure redaction.
- Financial templates retain permanent sample warnings. These are fictional props, not transaction evidence; customer billing and payment integrations are not enabled.
projects.rebuildNote: Original project. Actual local workspace screenshot with fictional content. GitHub checks do not automatically publish the separately managed Sites deployment.

projects.title: Korpeatech - Tech Solutions
projects.bodyText:
- A private local scope studio with an orange engineering-led identity: define a project's users, success measure, scope boundaries and testable acceptance criteria.
- Track risks and dependencies, compare immutable revisions, recover earlier scope and export a saved handoff as Markdown, JSON or a printable document.
- Password-gated, with stale-edit protection and safe retries. Ready means the planning checklist is complete, not that delivery is approved. No external request is sent.
projects.rebuildNote: Independently rebuilt in 2026 from the portfolio description and visual references. This is new source, not recovered code or an official company service. The repository includes local setup and tests; no public live deployment is claimed.

projects.title: CampusHub LTD -  EdTech
projects.bodyText:
- A private campus resale pilot with separate invited accounts, seller-owned listings and validated photo uploads.
- Buyers can reserve an item for 24 hours; sellers confirm handover and buyers confirm receipt. Version checks and SQLite transactions prevent competing holds and stale edits.
- Includes private reporting, operator review and desktop/mobile workflow tests. Local pilot only: no public deployment, payments, messaging or university identity verification.

projects.title: Billioncodes Software Inc.
projects.bodyText:
- A private freelancer proposal desk with a cream-and-terracotta editorial identity, original interface studies and operator-entered scope lines, quantities and rates.
- Uses explicit integer minor-unit rounding for discounts and tax, locks currency after saving, and preserves immutable revisions with price comparisons and restore.
- Export selected saved proposals as Markdown, JSON or printable documents. Legacy fictional estimates stay read-only. Local tool only: no client submission, signatures, invoicing or payments.

projects.title: Nifty's / Editions

- Add owned or licensed artworks with validated images, attribution and provenance notes; organise collections and freeze ordered exhibition revisions for printable sheets and JSON exports.
- Password-gated local workspace with revision recovery and protected images. Rights are operator-declared, not verified; no wallets, NFT transactions or public deployment.

- Local single-operator workspace with version recovery and retained drafts. Independent recreation, not connected Billups inventory, verified availability or a booking service.

projects.title: LibertyMutual
projects.bodyText:
- Coverline is a private offer evidence desk with the original yellow-and-navy identity.
- Record user-entered premiums, billing periods and source wording, preserve immutable revisions, and export frozen side-by-side comparisons. Missing details remain unknown.
- No insurer quote generation, coverage ranking, currency conversion or recommendation. Source text is not independently verified; this is a local single-operator review tool.

projects.title: Url Shortener
projects.bodyText:
- Littlelink manages campaign links without changing their short addresses: edit destinations, pause or resume redirects, and set UTC expiry.
- Built with Flask, Jinja2 and SQLite, with authenticated management, public redirects and visit counts.
- Stale-edit protection and atomic expiry checks are covered by API and desktop/mobile browser tests. A single-operator tool, not a public link-hosting service.
projects.rebuildNote: Rebuilt in 2026 from the original portfolio description. This is a new, independently tested implementation, not recovered source. See the repository for local setup; no replacement live deployment is claimed.

projects.title: Vidly App
projects.bodyText:
- Vidly is a cinematic private lending desk with physical-copy inventory, borrower references and overdue tracking.
- Maintain a real operator catalogue, record checkout and returns atomically, recover safely from retries, and inspect a persistent circulation ledger. Fictional film samples remain separate and read-only.
- Single-operator local pilot with authenticated exports and version-safe editing. No streaming, payments, automated reminders or delivery is provided.

projects.title: Bulk SMS Client App
projects.bodyText:
- Postroom is a private PHP test outbox with explicit channel consent and permanent suppression controls.
- Save and review single-recipient drafts, process durable attempts, recover after restart and retry deliberately with signed, replay-safe local callbacks.
- Synthetic recipients and a local test provider only. Simulation is not delivery: no real SMS, email, bulk outreach or external provider is connected.

projects.title: Staff Management System
projects.bodyText:
- People & Co. is a private staff desk with reviewed CSV intake, lifecycle history and reversible archiving.
- Preview every row, reject duplicates or stale reviews and confirm the batch atomically. Operator backup and restore preserve a recovery copy and invalidate old sessions.
- PHP and SQLite retain the original directory, search and export workflows. Shared local management identity; no public HR service, emergency-contact grants or encrypted storage is claimed.

projects.title: Angular Mini Projects
projects.bodyText:
- Smallwork is a private browser-only CSV/JSON workbench alongside its calculator, cipher and word tools.
- Validate files, preview transformations, review exact changes, undo or reset, compare structured versions and download results with formula-risk warnings. JSON number tokens retain their original precision.
- No uploads, accounts or saved browser storage. Sessions stay in memory with bounded inputs and 20 undo steps; the Caesar cipher remains educational, not secure encryption.

projects.title: Task Tracker
projects.bodyText:
- Daymark is a private task workspace with daily, weekly and monthly recurring work, notes, priorities and due dates.
- Completing an occurrence atomically creates one successor, preserves month-end schedules and prevents duplicate tasks on retries.
- Angular, an authenticated Express API and SQLite provide version-safe editing and persistence. Verified with calendar, rollback, concurrency and desktop/mobile browser tests; no background reminders are implied.

projects.title: Polytechnic Students Record System
projects.bodyText:
- Registrar is a local student-record workspace for macOS and Linux, with validated editing, search and spreadsheet-safe CSV export.
- Preview spreadsheet intake before importing: row-level errors, duplicate/conflict detection and one atomic write prevent partial imports or silent overwrites.
- File locking and revision checks reject stale edits. Unit tests and an actual Tkinter GUI smoke test cover the workflow; records stay on the operator's computer.
